raw_vs_diagnostic_contract: Exact opaque strings stay in canonical Trace/audit. Appended int64 carrier denotes comparable LIVE-policy step IDs only; strict canonical decimal 0 or[1-9][0-9]* bounded byint64; all other labels unknown-1, no dispatch fallback. This avoids duplicate opaque-string transport and does not claim lossless generic provenance in trainer packets.
independent_findings: WeightVersionSpan endpoints are completion ordinals, graph.commit prepends unsampled generation prefix; expansion must enumerate original True mask positions, not suffix offsets or dedup training mask.
Known labels survive shared-prefix context copies even when only first branch trains those actions. Newly rerendered unsampled prompt nodes stay unknown regardless of equal messages/token IDs.

Projection uses count of retained original sampled positions, clipping half-open spans without modifying source trace. Fully clipped suffix spans drop; zero-length in-bounds intervals are legal and contribute no labels.
Malformed bounds, negative endpoints, out-of-order or overlapping intervals reject instead of downgrading to unknown; default/opaque/out-of-range numeric labels are valid noncomparable labels.
Sink sampler.samples_from_live_policy is existing producer-origin authority. Frozen generator labels remain audit-only; do not infer live identity from numerical appearance.

Trainer CP gathers logprobs/entropy before shifting back to input-token coordinates. CPU carrier remains full physical input-token axis with no shift/CP rescale and never enters model/loss/value kwargs.
Optional field must append after existing array-like struct fields. Actually verify old omitted packet decode and None encoding rather than assume backward/rolling compatibility.
Mixed known/unknown packing needs unknown fill, truncation slices exactly, padding and dummy batches carry unknown. Decoder rejects wrongdtype/shape/bytecount and invalid negativevalues.
None/allunknown must count as unknown for any future diagnostic denominator, never silentlyfresh or excluded; age computation deferred until realbackend version publication and mixedreload proof.
bounded_acceptance: Literal ordinal oracle with non-suffix mask, sparse/opaque/default spans, clip crossing interval, sharedprefix dedup and frozen origin; malformedgeometry rejection/no mutation.
Actual response→canonical completeEpisode/msgpack→TrainSink/materializer→packer/CPU packet with deterministic labels; every preexisting numeric policy/value/credit field exactly unchanged.
Actual old/new codec compatibility, mixed absence, truncation/padding/dummy and unchanged full coordinate axis. No GPU/model rerun for observation-only metadata.
limits: Cannot establish engine attribution truth or reload correctness using synthetic response labels.
Live-policy source gate is only as authoritative as configured producer; generic custom cross-model programs need explicit identity contract before staleness comparisons.
Optional sampling-mask replay remains rejected; this carrier does not alter sampling distribution/objective/admission cohorts.
